raw:
Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 5  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly concluded that the election held after the 2016 Michigan Democratic primary was the next quadrennial presidential election on November 3, 2020, instead of the general election held later in the same year, on November 8, 2016. This error occurred because the Planner misinterpreted the task's requirements, which explicitly asked for the 58th quadrennial presidential election held after the Michigan Democratic primary in 2016. The Planner failed to recognize that the general election in November 2016 was part of the same 58th quadrennial election and was held after the Michigan Democratic primary in March 2016.
